Google's Google-only short links; the g.co page itself says so.
Linked from workspace.google.com; the bare goo.gle redirects to www.google.com.

Added in P11 (fix d). Google's developer page names imap.gmail.com, pop.gmail.com, smtp.gmail.com and smtp-relay.gmail.com. Its certificate names only gmail.com (no Organisation, no link to google.com), so the certificate can't prove it; the official list does. Found as live-feed false alarms on 2026-11-06.
